attributes.verification: NAMING AUTHORITY RECOVERED -- the prior lane's blocker (1) is REFUTED, not worked around. The block is the GC analogue of Xbox shell3D.pdb `struct P_SAVE_STATS` (Id=3351), research/xbox_symbols/misc.h:28873. Five independent corroborations: (a) size 0x1c = the proven 28-byte stride EXACTLY, and unlike its sibling P_SAVE_STUFF (0x254 Xbox vs 0xF0 GC) this record was NOT compacted on GC; (b) P_SAVE_STATS is the ONLY 28-byte game record in the PDB with an f32 at +0x18, and do_stats_display reads exactly +0x18 as f32 and divides it by 60.0f -- frames/60 -> seconds is precisely `float total_playtime`; (c) the Xbox `player` record carries `P_SAVE_STATS stats[16]` at 0x190 IMMEDIATELY followed by `P_SAVE_STUFF stuff[16]` at 0x350, and GC reproduces that adjacency exactly -- char_stats[16] spans 0xC10..0xDD0 (0x1C0, the identical array size Xbox reports) terminating 4 bytes before char_save[16] (already documented in player.h as the P_SAVE_STUFF analogue) at 0xDD4; (d) 16 elements indexed by Player.character, matching stats[16]; (e) the remaining GC-attested offsets +0x00/+0x10/+0x14 are all s32 in P_SAVE_STATS. The three fields at +0x04/+0x08/+0x0C are NOT GC-attested (the GC stats screen tallies only 4 rows) and are labelled as Xbox-carried-over in the header rather than claimed as verified. BYTE ACCOUNTING EXACT: 0x188 + 0x1C0 + 0x4 = 0x34C, so Player stays 0x335C and no later field moves. ISOLATION PROTOCOL: grep-derived includer list (23 TUs include game/player.h; 12 heavy//pad-region ones baselined) -- header edit gated ALONE with zero .c changes across game/shop/shop (the parent cascade law's own proving ground, ALL 14 functions incl. the exact 6 that PlayerShopStat regressed), game/game/player, game/game/gamemain, game/ui/select, game/enemy/enemy, game/game/pmotion, game/enemy/critter, game/world/tower, game/world/items, game/game/combat, game/ui/auxscreen, game/ui/screensaver = 12/12 GATE OK. Consumer conversion then measured probe NEUTRAL real 344 (insns 1087/1087, multiset 14t, unchanged from the pre-edit BASELINE) with defake_gate GATE OK on all 77 gamemain functions. NEW EVIDENCE BANKED: pad_0A88 now fully decomposes -- 0xA88..0xA90 (8B, holds the s16 char-type player.c reads at 0xA88), 0xA90..0xC10 = player.c's CHAR_STATS block (base 0xA90 stride 0x18, 16 entries ending EXACTLY at 0xC10), 0xC10..0xDD0 = char_stats[16], 0xDD0..0xDD4 (4B) -- 8 + 0x180 + 0x1C0 + 4 = 0x34C, leaving no unexplained bytes in the run.
